$comment: DRAFT – the output contract for one verdict. Align `call` with Stackgini's labels before building on it. Fields marked 'set by code' are never written by the LLM. Explained in docs/FILES.md.

call.description: if Stackgini's labels have no 'unclear', always make a call and use evidence_strength instead

evidence_strength.description: set by code: strong = at least two verified facts of different kinds

fact_id.description: the judge cites this ID; code maps it to url, quote and time

kind.description: quote = text on a page; measurement = a number we measured (404 count, RDAP date)

url.description: a page or record our pipeline fetched

quote.description: kind quote: verbatim from the fetched page

verification.description: set by code; a reason without exact or normalized match is dropped

not_checked.description: what we tried and could not check; never counted as a con

leads.description: hints from search snippets or model knowledge; never evidence
